columbia-mens-bugaboo-ii.name: Men's Bugaboo II Fleece Interchange Jacket
columbia-mens-bugaboo-ii.summary: Columbia describes the men's Bugaboo II as a 3-in-1 jacket with a waterproof-breathable outer shell and a fleece liner that can be worn separately or zipped together.

columbia-womens-bugaboo-iv.name: Women's Bugaboo IV Fleece Interchange Jacket
columbia-womens-bugaboo-iv.summary: Columbia's women's Bugaboo IV is a waterproof interchange jacket with a thermal-reflective lining and an MTR fleece liner.

columbia-mens-whirlibird-v.name: Men's Whirlibird V Interchange Jacket
columbia-mens-whirlibird-v.summary: Columbia calls the men's Whirlibird V a 3-in-1 ski jacket with a waterproof-breathable shell, thermal-reflective lining, and recycled polyester insulation.

columbia-womens-whirlibird-v.name: Women's Whirlibird V Interchange Jacket
